theme.style: Deep space-black atmospheric world charged with electric cyan and neon green light energy — the visual language of precision instrumentation and live data streams. Sweeping luminous arcs and floating particle fields create a sense of dynamic real-time intelligence. Lighting is dramatic and directional, with glowing beams cutting through near-black voids. Glass morphism layers and subtle grain texture add premium depth throughout.

slides.backgroundPrompt: Abstract digital art featuring sweeping arcs of electric cyan and neon green light ribbons erupting from the lower-left corner in a dramatic diagonal fan formation, cutting across a vast deep space-black void with intense luminous energy. Soft volumetric halos of aquamarine blue bleed outward from the ribbon cores, and thousands of micro-particles in pale cyan and bright mint are suspended in the mid-frame creating atmospheric depth and a sense of live data in motion. The upper 30% of the frame dissolves into a calm near-black for unobstructed text overlay, while the lower region blazes with high-contrast neon trails and subtle glass-morphism sheen. 8K quality, ultra smooth gradients, premium feel, no text, no letters, no UI elements, no device mockups
